#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <queue>
#include <utility>

using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;
typedef pair<ll, ll> pll;

class InputReader {
private:
    istream& stream;
    char buf[1024];
    int curChar, numChars;

public:
    InputReader(istream& s) : stream(s) {
        curChar = 0;
        numChars = 0;
    }

    int read() {
        if (numChars == -1) throw runtime_error("Input mismatch");
        if (curChar >= numChars) {
            curChar = 0;
            stream.read(buf, sizeof(buf));
            numChars = stream.gcount();
            if (numChars <= 0) return -1;
        }
        return buf[curChar++];
    }

    int readInt() {
        int c = read();
        while (c <= ' ') c = read();
        int sgn = 1;
        if (c == '-') { sgn = -1; c = read(); }
        int res = 0;
        do {
            if (c < '0' || c > '9') throw runtime_error("Input mismatch");
            res = res * 10 + c - '0';
            c = read();
        } while (c > ' ');
        return res * sgn;
    }

    string readString() {
        int c = read();
        while (c <= ' ') c = read();
        string res;
        do {
            if (c >= 0) res += (char)c;
            c = read();
        } while (c > ' ');
        return res;
    }
};

class Graph {
public:
    int vertexCount, edgeCount;
    vector<int> firstOutbound;
    vector<int> from, to, nextOutbound;
    vector<ll> weight, capacity;

    Graph(int vertexCount) : vertexCount(vertexCount), edgeCount(0) {
        firstOutbound.resize(vertexCount, -1);
        from.reserve(vertexCount);
        to.reserve(vertexCount);
        nextOutbound.reserve(vertexCount);
    }

    int addEdge(int u, int v, ll w, ll cap, int rev) {
        ensureCapacity(edgeCount + 1);
        nextOutbound[edgeCount] = firstOutbound[u];
        firstOutbound[u] = edgeCount;
        from[edgeCount] = u;
        to[edgeCount] = v;
        if (cap != 0) {
            if (capacity.empty()) capacity.resize(from.size(), 0);
            capacity[edgeCount] = cap;
        }
        if (w != 0) {
            if (weight.empty()) weight.resize(from.size(), 0);
            weight[edgeCount] = w;
        }
        return edgeCount++;
    }

    int addFlowWeightedEdge(int u, int v, ll w, ll cap) {
        if (cap == 0) return addEdge(u, v, w, 0, -1);
        int last = edgeCount;
        addEdge(v, u, -w, 0, -1);
        return addEdge(u, v, w, cap, -1);
    }

    void ensureCapacity(int size) {
        if ((int)from.size() < size) {
            int newSize = max(size, (int)from.size() * 2);
            from.resize(newSize);
            to.resize(newSize);
            nextOutbound.resize(newSize);
            if (!weight.empty()) weight.resize(newSize);
            if (!capacity.empty()) capacity.resize(newSize);
        }
    }

    int firstOutbound(int v) { return firstOutbound[v]; }
    int nextOutbound(int id) { return nextOutbound[id]; }
    int source(int id) { return from[id]; }
    int destination(int id) { return to[id]; }
    ll weight(int id) { return weight.empty() ? 0 : weight[id]; }
    ll capacity(int id) { return capacity.empty() ? 0 : capacity[id]; }

    void pushFlow(int id, ll f) {
        if (f == 0) return;
        capacity[id] -= f;
        capacity[id ^ 1] += f;
    }
};

class MinCostFlow {
private:
    const Graph* g;
    int src, dst;
    vector<ll> phi;
    vector<ll> dist;
    vector<int> prev;
    int n;
    vector<int> visited;
    int visitIdx;

    void fordBellman() {
        fill(phi.begin(), phi.end(), LLONG_MAX);
        phi[src] = 0;
        vector<bool> inQ(n, false);
        vector<int> q(n + 1);
        int head = 0, tail = 0;
        q[tail++] = src;
        inQ[src] = true;
        int steps = 0, maxSteps = 2 * n * n;
        while (head != tail) {
            int u = q[head++];
            if (head == n) head = 0;
            inQ[u] = false;
            for (int e = g->firstOutbound(u); e != -1; e = g->nextOutbound(e)) {
                if (g->capacity(e) == 0) continue;
                int v = g->destination(e);
                ll nd = phi[u] + g->weight(e);
                if (phi[v] > nd) {
                    phi[v] = nd;
                    if (!inQ[v]) {
                        q[tail++] = v;
                        inQ[v] = true;
                        if (tail == n) tail = 0;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (++steps > maxSteps) throw runtime_error("Negative cycle");
        }
    }

    void dijkstra() {
        fill(dist.begin(), dist.end(), LLONG_MAX);
        fill(prev.begin(), prev.end(), -1);
        dist[src] = 0;
        
        priority_queue<pll, vector<pll>, greater<pll>> pq;
        pq.push({0, src});
        
        while (!pq.empty()) {
            auto [d, u] = pq.top();
            pq.pop();
            if (d != dist[u]) continue;
            
            for (int e = g->firstOutbound(u); e != -1; e = g->nextOutbound(e)) {
                if (g->capacity(e) == 0) continue;
                int v = g->destination(e);
                ll nd = dist[u] + g->weight(e) - phi[v] + phi[u];
                if (dist[v] > nd) {
                    dist[v] = nd;
                    prev[v] = e;
                    pq.push({nd, v});
                }
            }
        }
    }

public:
    MinCostFlow(const Graph* g, int src, int dst, bool hasNeg) 
        : g(g), src(src), dst(dst), n(g->vertexCount) {
        phi.resize(n);
        dist.resize(n);
        prev.resize(n);
        if (hasNeg) fordBellman();
    }

    static pll minCostMaxFlow(const Graph* g, int s, int d, bool hasNeg, ll maxF) {
        return MinCostFlow(g, s, d, hasNeg).run(maxF);
    }

    pll run(ll maxF) {
        ll cost = 0, flow = 0;
        while (maxF > 0) {
            dijkstra();
            if (prev[dst] == -1) break;
            
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                if (dist[i] != LLONG_MAX) phi[i] += dist[i];
            }
            
            ll f = maxF;
            for (int v = dst; v != src; v = g->source(prev[v])) {
                f = min(f, g->capacity(prev[v]));
            }
            maxF -= f;
            
            ll c = 0;
            for (int v = dst; v != src; v = g->source(prev[v])) {
                c += g->weight(prev[v]);
            }
            cost += c * f;
            flow += f;
            
            for (int v = dst; v != src; v = g->source(prev[v])) {
                g->pushFlow(prev[v], f);
            }
        }
        return {cost, flow};
    }
};

int main() {
    try {
        InputReader reader(cin);
        int n = reader.readInt();
        string s = reader.readString();
        vector<int> ugliness(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ugliness[i] = -reader.readInt();
        }

        Graph graph(1 + 26 + n / 2 + 1);
        for (char c = 'a'; c <= 'z'; c++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) {
                int cost = 0;
                if (c == s[i]) cost = min(cost, ugliness[i]);
                if (c == s[n - 1 - i]) cost = min(cost, ugliness[n - 1 - i]);
                graph.addFlowWeightedEdge(1 + (c - 'a'), 1 + 26 + i, cost, 1);
            }
        }

        vector<int> occurs(128, 0);
        for (char ch : s) occurs[ch]++;
        for (char c = 'a'; c <= 'z'; c++) {
            graph.addFlowWeightedEdge(0, 1 + (c - 'a'), 0, occurs[c]);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) {
            graph.addFlowWeightedEdge(1 + 26 + i, 1 + 26 + n / 2, 0, 2);
        }

        pll flow = MinCostFlow::minCostMaxFlow(&graph, 0, 1 + 26 + n / 2, true, n);
        cout << -flow.first << endl;
    } catch (const exception& e) {
        cerr << "Error: " << e.what() << endl;
        return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}
